facts.fact: BCEAO rules in force from 2 November 2026 require all interoperable electronic money transfers between individuals within WAEMU to go through PI-SPI, with free domestic transfers up to CFAF 8,000 a day.
From 2 November 2026 interoperable e-money transfers between individuals within WAEMU must go through PI-SPI, a rule requiring providers to route through the platform.
